hints.title: Character Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count the occurrences of letter in the string s.

hints.title: Percentage Formula with Truncation
hints.text: Multiply matching letter count by 100, then apply integer division by total length len(s).

hints.title: Immediate Integer Arithmetic
hints.text: Formula: (count * 100) // len(s) directly truncates down without floating-point errors.

hints.title: Letter Percentage Calculation Implementation
